lessons.key: surviving_mutant::test ttl threshold comparisons at the exact boundary value not only just inside and just outside it so a vs mutation is caught
lessons.text: Test TTL/threshold comparisons at the exact boundary value, not only just-inside and just-outside it, so a > vs >= mutation is caught.

lessons.text: When a hook's behavior is scoped by a static matcher/config string, assert the exact matcher value in a test, not just the resulting command string.
